prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on where you are in Houston and what you need (emergency repair vs routine fix, single window unit vs whole-house system, budget, warranty preferences). I can find locally top-rated companies for your exact ZIP code — would you like me to do that?

Until then, here’s how to identify the best HVAC company for AC repair and what to ask them:

What makes a company “best”
- Proper licensure and insurance (ask for license number and proof of liability insurance)
- NATE- or factory-certified technicians (shows training on specific brands)
- Strong, recent customer reviews on Google/Yelp and a good BBB rating
- Clear, written estimates and pricing (diagnostic fee, parts, labor)
- Warranties on parts and labor
- Availability for emergency/after-hours service if needed
- Upfront communication and written invoice with details of work done

Questions to ask before you hire
- Are you licensed and insured? (ask for license number)
- Do you have experience with my brand/model?
- What is the diagnostic fee? Is it applied to the repair cost?
- What parts and labor warranties do you provide?
- Can I get a written estimate and timeline?
- Do you offer maintenance plans?

Red flags
- Technician refuses to show ID or license
- Company pressures you into a full replacement without providing diagnostics
- Vague or no written estimate
- Very low price with no warranty or poor reviews

If you want, tell me your ZIP code or neighborhood and whether this is an emergency repair. I’ll pull the top-rated local HVAC companies in Houston, list their specialties, and give contact info and a short comparison.
